title: 6 · Record → refresh tracker → one coherent commit
summary: Commit meaningful design/behavior/checkpoint changes separately; do not bundle unrelated fixes.
body:
Commit meaningful design/behavior/checkpoint changes separately; do not bundle unrelated fixes.

Label with task/issue plus short problem, change, evidence and scope. Git supplies ID/time.

Trace: task → issue/example → change → commit → application run.

Preserve starting checkpoint; label unfinished work honestly; update current state/next action before a new session.

Keep credentials and private generated application payloads out of Git; link local evidence.

PR only when useful/authorized; a local commit does not require publication. Revert a specific change when appropriate.

Temporal here means versioned history over time, not installing the Temporal platform.
